title: WORK WORDS 500
note: 1枚が1語。英文は全部自作(試験の過去問や市販教材からの転載なし)。語と意味と点数帯の元は、とにおラボの頻出310語。pos は品詞で、カードの属性になる(動詞=flame、名詞=earth、形容詞=wind、副詞=thunder、熟語=aqua)。band は TOEIC の点数帯で、章になる。cost は対戦のコスト。tone は英文の型。

cards.line: Fools! I shall postpone the end of the world until after lunch.
cards.lineJa: 愚か者め！世界の終わりは、昼食のあとまで延期してやる。
cards.scene: A caped supervillain on a rooftop pauses his giant doomsday machine with one hand on a big lever, a wall calendar and a lunch tray with a sandwich beside him, terrified citizens below looking confused.

voice.direction: Booming and menacing on 'Fools!', then oddly practical and calm on 'until after lunch'. Stress 'postpone'.

cards.ja: (立て替えた費用を)払い戻す
cards.line: The captain will reimburse you for the parrot. Keep the receipt.
cards.lineJa: オウムの代金は船長が払い戻してくれる。領収書は取っておけ。
cards.scene: On a pirate ship deck, a stern pirate bookkeeper hands gold coins to a young sailor who holds a colorful parrot on his arm and a long paper receipt in the other hand.

voice.direction: Rough pirate growl but businesslike, like an office memo. Stress 'reimburse'. Firm on 'Keep the receipt'.

cards.line: I forgot to renew my magic license, so today I am just an old man with a stick.
cards.lineJa: 魔法の免許を更新し忘れた。だから今日のわしは、棒を持ったただの老人じゃ。
cards.scene: A long-bearded old wizard stands sadly at a government office counter holding an expired license card, his staff producing no magic, while a bored clerk points at a calendar.

voice.direction: Weary and self-pitying, slow, a small sigh before 'so today'. Stress 'renew'.

cards.line: I did submit my report on time. The dragon ate the printer.
cards.lineJa: レポートは期限どおりに提出しました。ドラゴンがプリンターを食べたんです。
cards.scene: A nervous young office worker hands a folder to a boss across a desk, while behind them through the doorway a small dragon chews on an office printer, paper flying.

voice.direction: Defensive and fast, voice cracking slightly. Strong stress on 'did submit'. Flat and matter-of-fact on the dragon.

cards.line: Can anyone confirm where you were when the last donut disappeared?
cards.lineJa: 最後のドーナツが消えたとき、あなたがどこにいたか、確認できる人はいますか？
cards.scene: A trench-coated detective shines a desk lamp on a sweating office worker with sugar on his lips, an empty donut box on the table between them, in a dark interrogation room.

voice.direction: Low, slow, suspicious. Pause after 'confirm'. Treat the donut as a serious crime.

cards.line: Could you extend my lunch break by three hours? I am very hungry.
cards.lineJa: 昼休みを3時間、延長してもらえますか。とてもお腹が空いているんです。
cards.scene: A huge hungry employee sits at a cafeteria table behind a towering pile of empty plates, politely raising one finger toward a manager who stares at a wall clock.

voice.direction: Polite and hopeful, as if it is a small favor. Stress 'extend' and 'three hours'. Sincere on 'very hungry'.

cards.line: Even after death, the invoice arrived on the first of the month.
cards.lineJa: 死んだあとも、請求書は毎月1日に届いた。
cards.scene: A translucent ghost in a moonlit graveyard stares in dismay at an envelope with a bill inside, delivered by a skeletal postman on a bicycle, a tombstone mailbox beside them.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan sorrow. Slow. Stress 'invoice'.

cards.line: This summer, one man will face his greatest enemy: the Monday deadline.
cards.lineJa: この夏、ひとりの男が最大の敵に立ち向かう。月曜の締め切りだ。
cards.scene: A heroic office worker in a torn shirt and loose tie stands with a stapler like a weapon, facing a gigantic monstrous calendar page with a red circle around Monday, explosions behind.

voice.direction: Deep epic trailer voice, dramatic pauses after 'This summer' and before 'the Monday deadline'.

cards.line: I would like a refund. This crystal ball only shows reruns.
cards.lineJa: 返金をお願いします。この水晶玉、再放送しか映らないんです。
cards.scene: An annoyed customer places a crystal ball on a fortune teller's shop counter and holds out an open hand for money; inside the ball an old black-and-white TV show is playing.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, firm. Stress 'refund'. Dry disappointment on 'reruns'.

cards.line: Good news, sir knight! Dragon burns are covered by the warranty.
cards.lineJa: 朗報です、騎士様！ドラゴンによる焦げは保証の対象です。
cards.scene: A smiling shop clerk holds up a certificate with a ribbon seal to a knight whose armor is blackened and still smoking, a small dragon peeking from behind the shop shelf.

voice.direction: Bright, delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'warranty'.

cards.line: First item on the agenda: who keeps stealing the king's pudding?
cards.lineJa: 議題の1つ目。王様のプリンを盗み続けているのは誰か。
cards.scene: A royal council at a long table, a herald unrolling a long scroll list, the king pointing angrily at an empty dessert plate, one guilty-looking minister with pudding on his beard.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'agenda'. Completely serious about the pudding.

cards.line: Inventory check complete. We have nine hundred forks and zero spoons.
cards.lineJa: 在庫の確認が完了しました。フォークが900本、スプーンは0本です。
cards.scene: A small boxy robot with a clipboard stands in a warehouse aisle between shelves overflowing with thousands of forks, next to one completely empty shelf, a chef holding a soup bowl looking desperate.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses between phrases. Stress 'Inventory' and 'zero spoons'.

cards.ja: 空いている、利用できる
cards.line: The doctor is available on Tuesday. Unfortunately, the doctor is also a penguin.
cards.lineJa: 先生は火曜日なら空いています。ただ残念ながら、先生はペンギンでもあります。
cards.scene: A clinic reception desk with a friendly receptionist pointing at a weekly schedule board, and behind her through an open door a penguin in a white coat with a stethoscope waits in the exam room.

voice.direction: Warm and professional. Stress 'available'. Slightly apologetic on 'Unfortunately'.

cards.line: Attendance at the fun party is mandatory. Smiling is also mandatory.
cards.lineJa: 楽しいパーティーへの出席は必須です。笑顔も必須です。
cards.scene: A stern boss with a megaphone points at a row of office workers wearing party hats and forced stiff smiles, balloons and a banner above them, a clipboard checklist in the boss's hand.

voice.direction: Cold, flat, no joy at all. Hard stress on both 'mandatory'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: This umbrella is defective, dear. It only works when it is sunny.
cards.lineJa: この傘は不良品だよ。晴れてるときしか役に立たないんだから。
cards.scene: A kind grandmother stands soaked in pouring rain holding an umbrella that is full of holes and turned inside out, showing it to a child in a raincoat.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, amused. Stress 'defective'. Light chuckle feeling on 'sunny'.

cards.line: We have a tentative plan to save the kingdom, but it depends on the weather.
cards.lineJa: 王国を救う仮の計画はある。ただし、天気しだいだ。
cards.scene: A hesitant general in armor points at a battle map covered with pencil sketches, question marks and eraser marks, while an advisor looks out the tent at dark rain clouds.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, then loses it. Stress 'tentative'. Sheepish on 'the weather'.

cards.line: Please leave the volcano promptly. Thank you for flying with us.
cards.lineJa: 火山からすみやかに退出してください。ご搭乗ありがとうございました。
cards.scene: A small passenger plane parked on the rim of an erupting volcano, a calm flight attendant at the door gesturing passengers to run down the stairs with their suitcases, lava glowing.

voice.direction: Perfectly calm, smooth announcement voice despite the danger. Stress 'promptly'.

cards.line: The moon is temporarily closed for cleaning.
cards.lineJa: 月は、清掃のため一時的に閉鎖しています。
cards.scene: The full moon in a night sky with a hanging closed sign and a rope barrier around it, a tiny astronaut janitor mopping its surface with a bucket, stars watching.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral and quick. Stress 'temporarily'.

cards.line: Nobody knows who put the cat in charge of the budget, but sales are up.
cards.lineJa: 誰が猫を予算の担当にしたのかは、誰も知らない。でも売上は伸びている。
cards.scene: A confident cat wearing a tiny tie sits in a big executive chair behind a desk, one paw on a calculator, a rising sales chart on the wall, amazed employees peeking through the door.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial whisper, then impressed and upbeat on 'but sales are up'. Stress 'in charge of'.

cards.line: On behalf of all the vegetables, I would like to say: please stop boiling us.
cards.lineJa: 野菜一同を代表して申し上げます。私たちをゆでるのは、やめてください。
cards.scene: A dignified carrot stands at a tiny podium with a microphone giving a speech, a crowd of worried vegetables behind it holding protest signs with no words, a large steaming pot looming nearby.

voice.direction: Formal speech tone, earnest and brave, slight tremble on 'please stop boiling us'. Stress 'On behalf of'.

cards.line: You claim you were at home, but your shoes claim otherwise.
cards.lineJa: 家にいたと君は主張する。だが君の靴は、ちがうと主張している。
cards.scene: A detective points a magnifying glass at the very muddy shoes of a nervous suspect sitting on a clean living-room sofa.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'claim'.

cards.line: This hotel can accommodate two hundred guests, or one dragon.
cards.lineJa: このホテルは200名様を収容できます。あるいは、ドラゴン1頭。
cards.scene: A grand hotel lobby where a smiling receptionist greets a huge dragon squeezing through the front door with a small suitcase.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'accommodate'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: Be sensible, dear. Nobody fights a dragon before breakfast.
cards.lineJa: 分別を持ちなさい。朝ごはんの前にドラゴンと戦う人はいないよ。
cards.scene: A grandmother sets a breakfast plate in front of a young knight in full armor who is itching to leave, a dragon visible through the kitchen window.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'sensible'.

cards.line: Please verify that you are human. Barking is not accepted.
cards.lineJa: あなたが人間であることを確認してください。吠えるのは受け付けません。
cards.scene: A dog wearing a business suit sits at a computer terminal while a security robot points sternly at the screen.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'verify'.

cards.line: We do not negotiate with seagulls. They always want the fries.
cards.lineJa: カモメとは交渉しない。あいつらは必ずポテトを要求する。
cards.scene: A pirate captain sits with arms crossed at a table facing a row of determined seagulls staring at a basket of fries.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'negotiate'.

cards.line: Your work is adequate. That is the nicest thing I have ever said.
cards.lineJa: 君の仕事は、まあ十分だ。これは私が今までに言った中で、いちばんの褒め言葉だ。
cards.scene: A stone-faced boss hands a very small ribbon to an employee who is crying tears of joy.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'adequate'.

cards.line: The new vendor delivers on time, but only by catapult.
cards.lineJa: 新しい業者は納期を守る。ただし、投石機でしか届けない。
cards.scene: Cardboard boxes fly through the air toward an office building, launched from a medieval catapult, while office workers duck.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'vendor'.

cards.line: Today's itinerary: breakfast, the haunted castle, lunch, and regret.
cards.lineJa: 本日の旅程です。朝食、幽霊の出る城、昼食、そして後悔。
cards.scene: A cheerful tour guide with a little flag leads nervous tourists toward a dark haunted castle, holding a schedule sheet.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'itinerary'.

cards.line: This coffee will facilitate your meeting. The second cup will end it.
cards.lineJa: このコーヒーは会議を円滑にします。2杯目は、会議を終わらせます。
cards.scene: A barista serves a giant cup of coffee to a sleepy meeting table; one attendee who already drank it is vibrating with wide eyes.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'facilitate'.

cards.line: Prices fluctuate daily. So does my boss's mood.
cards.lineJa: 価格は毎日変動する。上司の機嫌も同じだ。
cards.scene: A zigzag price chart on the wall is mirrored by a boss whose face switches between a happy mask and an angry mask.

voice.direction: Brisk and sunny. Stress 'fluctuate'.

cards.line: According to protocol, we must greet the humans before taking their snacks.
cards.lineJa: 規定によれば、おやつをいただく前に、まず人類にあいさつをしなければならない。
cards.scene: Small aliens stand beside a picnic blanket reading a thick manual, while one of them reaches toward a bag of chips.

voice.direction: Careful, curious, slightly stiff. Stress 'protocol'.

cards.line: Even a magic wand suffers depreciation. Mine now only makes toast.
cards.lineJa: 魔法の杖にも価値の低下はある。わしの杖は、もうトーストしか作れん。
cards.scene: An old wizard points his worn wand dramatically and a single slice of toast pops out of the tip.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'depreciation'.

cards.line: The meeting will resume as soon as someone finds the manager under the paperwork.
cards.lineJa: 部長が書類の山の下から見つかりしだい、会議を再開します。
cards.scene: A mountain of paper covers a meeting table with one hand sticking out of it, while colleagues dig with shovels.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'resume'.

cards.line: I always comply with the rules. I just read them very slowly.
cards.lineJa: 規則にはいつも従っています。ただ、読むのがとても遅いだけです。
cards.scene: A sloth in office clothes calmly reads an enormous rulebook at a desk while an alarm bell rings and coworkers run past.

voice.direction: Sincere and unhurried. Stress 'comply'.

cards.line: I need your consent before I remove the sword from your head.
cards.lineJa: 頭の剣を抜く前に、あなたの同意が必要です。
cards.scene: A doctor holds out a clipboard and pen to a knight who sits calmly on the exam table with a sword stuck through his helmet.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'consent'.

cards.line: Please dispose of your old armor properly. The lake is not a trash can.
cards.lineJa: 古い鎧は正しく処分してください。湖はごみ箱ではありません。
cards.scene: An annoyed lake spirit rises from the water holding rusty pieces of armor, glaring at a guilty knight on the shore.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'dispose'.

cards.line: Running away is still a viable option, sir.
cards.lineJa: 逃げるというのも、まだ実行可能な選択肢です、閣下。
cards.scene: A tiny army faces a gigantic monster; an advisor whispers to the general and points discreetly backward.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'viable'.

cards.line: Three candidates. One job. Zero idea what the job is.
cards.lineJa: 候補者は3人。仕事は1つ。その仕事が何なのかは、誰も知らない。
cards.scene: Three nervous people in suits sit in a waiting room under a single spotlight, facing a mysterious closed door.

voice.direction: Deep and epic, with dramatic pauses between sentences. Stress 'candidate'.

cards.line: The next applicant has nine lives of work experience.
cards.lineJa: 次の応募者は、9回ぶんの人生の職歴をお持ちです。
cards.scene: A cat wearing a tie sits at a job interview and slides a very thick stack of papers toward impressed interviewers.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'applicant'.

cards.line: The shareholders demand answers. Also, more cookies at the meeting.
cards.lineJa: 株主の皆さまは説明を求めています。あと、総会のクッキーの増量も。
cards.scene: An angry crowd of elderly shareholders waves empty cookie plates at a sweating speaker on a podium.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'shareholder'.

cards.line: Please hold. A representative will ignore you shortly.
cards.lineJa: そのままお待ちください。まもなく担当者が、あなたを無視します。
cards.scene: A skeleton covered in cobwebs sits in an armchair still holding a telephone to its ear, musical notes floating from the receiver.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, dry. Stress 'representative'.

cards.line: The intern fixed the server by turning the whole building off and on again.
cards.lineJa: インターンは、ビルごと電源を入れ直してサーバーを直した。
cards.scene: A proud young intern pulls a giant power lever while every window of a tall office building flickers dark and bright.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'intern'.

cards.line: My colleague is a cat. He attends every meeting and contributes nothing, like everyone else.
cards.lineJa: 私の同僚は猫だ。会議には毎回出るが、何も貢献しない。みんなと同じだ。
cards.scene: A cat sits upright in an office chair at a meeting table among bored human coworkers, a laptop open in front of it.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'colleague'.

cards.line: I do not recruit minions. They apply.
cards.lineJa: 手下は採用しない。向こうから応募してくるのだ。
cards.scene: A villain lounges on a throne while a very long line of small creatures waits, each holding a sheet of paper.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'recruit'.

cards.line: Please distribute these flyers. Not to the pigeons this time.
cards.lineJa: このチラシを配ってください。今回は、ハトにではなく。
cards.scene: A young employee in a park hands out leaflets to a flock of pigeons, each pigeon holding one in its beak.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'distribute'.

cards.line: I have calculated your chances of leaving on time. Please sit down.
cards.lineJa: 定時で帰れる確率を計算しました。どうぞ、お座りください。
cards.scene: A robot holding a long printout blocks the office door in front of a tired worker who already has a coat and bag on.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'calculate'.

cards.line: This spray will eliminate ninety-nine percent of Mondays.
cards.lineJa: このスプレーは、月曜日の99パーセントを除去します。
cards.scene: A grinning salesperson sprays a wall calendar and one column of days dissolves into sparkles.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'eliminate'.

cards.line: Breakfast is complimentary. The dragon insurance is not.
cards.lineJa: 朝食は無料です。ドラゴン保険は、無料ではありません。
cards.scene: An elegant hotel breakfast buffet with happy guests, while a dragon peeks in through the tall window behind them.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'complimentary'.

cards.line: He has now lost for nine consecutive days, and the crowd loves him for it.
cards.lineJa: 彼はこれで9日連続の負けです。そして観客は、そんな彼が大好きです。
cards.scene: A tired wrestler lies face down in the ring while the crowd cheers wildly and throws flowers.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'consecutive'.

cards.line: This offer is exclusive to members, and to anyone who asks nicely.
cards.lineJa: この特典は会員限定です。あと、感じよく頼んだ人にも。
cards.scene: A huge bouncer at a velvet rope melts into a smile as a tiny grandmother offers him a plate of cookies.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'exclusive'.

cards.line: After extensive research, we found the missing pen. It was behind his ear.
cards.lineJa: 広範な調査の結果、なくなったペンを発見しました。彼の耳の後ろにありました。
cards.scene: A research team stands before walls of charts and maps, all pointing at a confused man with a pen tucked behind his ear.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'extensive'.

cards.ja: 広く見られる、普及している
cards.line: Yawning is now prevalent in every meeting room in the country.
cards.lineJa: あくびは今や、全国すべての会議室で広く見られます。
cards.scene: A meeting room where every person yawns widely at the same time, including the portrait hanging on the wall.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'prevalent'.

cards.line: Resistance is useless. The Monday meeting is inevitable.
cards.lineJa: 抵抗は無駄だ。月曜の会議は、避けられない。
cards.scene: A dark overlord in a cape points down a corridor at office workers fleeing from a gigantic rolling calendar.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'inevitable'.

cards.line: Our next opponent is formidable. She is seven years old and never gets tired.
cards.lineJa: 次の対戦相手は手ごわい。7歳で、決して疲れません。
cards.scene: An exhausted adult chess master slumps at the board across from a grinning little girl bouncing in her chair.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'formidable'.

cards.line: This versatile tool opens bottles, cuts paper, and ends arguments.
cards.lineJa: この万能ツールは、びんを開け、紙を切り、口論を終わらせます。
cards.scene: A pocket multi-tool with dozens of unfolded gadgets, shown in the center, with two tiny arguing figures falling silent beside it.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'versatile'.

cards.line: One small typo can bring about the end of a kingdom.
cards.lineJa: 小さな打ちまちがい1つが、王国の終わりをもたらすことがある。
cards.scene: A horrified scribe stares at his scroll while, outside the window, an army marches confidently in the wrong direction.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'bring about'.

cards.line: We will carry out the plan at dawn. Or after coffee, whichever is later.
cards.lineJa: 計画は夜明けに実行する。あるいはコーヒーのあと。どちらか遅いほうだ。
cards.scene: Sleepy soldiers in a command tent hold coffee mugs while a yawning general leans on the map table at sunrise.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'carry out'.

cards.ja: 追って連絡する、後で確認する
cards.line: I will follow up on that email. I have been dead for a century, but I will follow up.
cards.lineJa: あのメールの件は、追って連絡します。死んで100年になりますが、追って連絡します。
cards.scene: A translucent ghost in an old suit types at a dusty computer in an abandoned office full of cobwebs.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'follow up'.

cards.line: We will look into the missing cake. Please stop licking the evidence.
cards.lineJa: 消えたケーキの件は調査します。証拠をなめるのは、やめてください。
cards.scene: A detective writes in a notepad next to an empty cake stand while his assistant licks frosting off a plate.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'look into'.

cards.line: As of today, the office dog is officially the manager.
cards.lineJa: 本日付で、オフィスの犬が正式に部長になりました。
cards.scene: A dog wearing a tie sits proudly in a big executive chair while the office staff applaud around the desk.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'as of'.

cards.line: Your condition will deteriorate if you keep reading emails at midnight.
cards.lineJa: 夜中にメールを読み続けると、症状は悪化しますよ。
cards.scene: A doctor examines a hollow-eyed office worker who sits in bed at night lit only by the glow of a phone.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'deteriorate'.

cards.line: The repair will take approximately five minutes, or three weeks.
cards.lineJa: 修理には、およそ5分、または3週間かかります。
cards.scene: A repair robot shrugs next to a broken elevator with parts scattered everywhere, a crowd waiting with crossed arms.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'approximately'.

cards.line: The dragon is relatively friendly. It only burned one village.
cards.lineJa: あのドラゴンは比較的おとなしい。焼いた村は、1つだけだ。
cards.scene: A guide proudly introduces a smiling dragon to worried villagers, with one smoking ruin far in the background.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'relatively'.

cards.line: A parrot was hired to oversee the project. It repeats every deadline.
cards.lineJa: プロジェクトの監督に、オウムが雇われた。締め切りを全部、くり返してくる。
cards.scene: A colorful parrot perches above a construction site wearing a tiny hard hat, squawking down at tired workers.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'oversee'.

cards.line: Any sailor who sings off-key will incur a fine of two gold coins.
cards.lineJa: 音を外して歌った船乗りは、金貨2枚の罰金を負う。
cards.scene: A captain holds out a jar while an embarrassed singing sailor drops two coins into it, the crew covering their ears.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'incur'.

cards.line: Lunch breaks are at the manager's discretion, and the manager is never hungry.
cards.lineJa: 昼休みは部長の裁量で決まる。そして部長は、決して腹が減らない。
cards.scene: A stern manager sits like a statue at his desk while starving employees clutch lunchboxes and stare at the wall clock.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'discretion'.

cards.line: We will waive the delivery fee if you carry the piano yourself.
cards.lineJa: ピアノをご自分で運んでいただければ、配送料は免除します。
cards.scene: A smiling shop clerk waves goodbye as a customer staggers out of the store carrying a grand piano on his back.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'waive'.

cards.line: The brochure promised a quiet beach. It did not mention the penguin parade.
cards.lineJa: パンフレットには、静かなビーチとありました。ペンギンの行進のことは、書いてありませんでした。
cards.scene: A sunbather on a beach towel holds a folded leaflet while a loud marching band of penguins parades around her.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, dry. Stress 'brochure'.

cards.line: I forgot the attachment again. Please enjoy this empty email.
cards.lineJa: また添付を忘れました。この空っぽのメールを、お楽しみください。
cards.scene: An office worker peers into a large open envelope that has nothing inside, turning it upside down and shaking it.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'attachment'.

cards.line: Someone put a flyer on the dragon. It now has many customers.
cards.lineJa: 誰かがドラゴンにチラシを貼った。おかげで、お客がたくさん来ている。
cards.scene: A sleeping dragon with a paper notice stuck to its side, and a long patient queue of villagers waiting in front of it.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'flyer'.

cards.line: Nobody reads the company newsletter, so I hid my resignation in it.
cards.lineJa: 社内報は誰も読まない。だから私は、そこに辞表を隠した。
cards.scene: An employee tiptoes out of the office with a suitcase while the boss drops an unread folded bulletin into the bin.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'newsletter'.

cards.line: Read the safety pamphlet before you open the cursed box. Too late, I see.
cards.lineJa: 呪いの箱を開ける前に、安全のしおりを読むのだ。…手遅れか。
cards.scene: An apprentice holds an open glowing box with tentacles pouring out while a wizard beside him holds a small booklet and covers his face.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'pamphlet'.

cards.line: This magic bean will yield one giant pumpkin and several lawsuits.
cards.lineJa: この魔法の豆は、巨大なかぼちゃ1個と、訴訟を数件生み出します。
cards.scene: A farmer stands proudly beside a house-sized pumpkin that has crushed the neighbor's fence, the neighbors arriving with briefcases.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'yield'.

cards.line: The king will allocate half the budget to cake. The other half is also for cake.
cards.lineJa: 王は、予算の半分をケーキに割り当てる。残りの半分もケーキだ。
cards.scene: A king divides a pile of gold into two heaps with his scepter, a towering cake beside each heap, the treasurer fainting.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'allocate'.

cards.line: Your question does not pertain to this meeting, but yes, the cat is mine.
cards.lineJa: ご質問は、この会議には関係ありません。ですが、ええ、その猫は私のです。
cards.scene: A presenter stands at a whiteboard with a cat sitting on top of his head while an attendee raises a hand.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'pertain'.

cards.line: Revenue doubled this year. So did the number of meetings about revenue.
cards.lineJa: 収益は今年、2倍になった。収益についての会議の数も、2倍になった。
cards.scene: A rising bar chart glows on a big screen while identical meeting rooms full of people multiply into the distance.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'revenue'.

cards.line: We offer a substantial discount to customers who stop asking for discounts.
cards.lineJa: 値引きを求めるのをやめたお客様には、かなりの値引きをいたします。
cards.scene: A beaming shopkeeper hands an enormous coupon to a customer who is covering his own mouth with both hands.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'substantial'.

cards.line: Show some initiative. But ask me first.
cards.lineJa: 自発性を見せなさい。ただし、先に私に聞くこと。
cards.scene: A boss points heroically forward while an employee freezes mid-stride with one hand raised to ask permission.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'initiative'.

cards.line: We will implement the new system on Monday and blame it by Tuesday.
cards.lineJa: 新しいシステムは月曜に導入します。火曜には、そのせいにします。
cards.scene: Office workers proudly unveil a giant shiny machine; beside it the same workers all point accusing fingers at it.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'implement'.

cards.ja: 明示する、具体的に述べる
cards.line: You asked for a horse. You did not specify that it should be alive.
cards.lineJa: 馬を、とのご注文でした。生きていること、とは明示されていませんでした。
cards.scene: A calm merchant presents a wooden rocking horse to a furious knight in full armor.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, dry. Stress 'specify'.

cards.line: Leaving the dragon's cage open was a small oversight.
cards.lineJa: ドラゴンの檻を開けっぱなしにしたのは、ちょっとした見落としでした。
cards.scene: A sheepish zookeeper stands beside a wide-open cage while a dragon flies away over a distant smoking town.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'oversight'.

cards.line: She is proficient in five languages and silent in all of them during meetings.
cards.lineJa: 彼女は5か国語に堪能だ。そして会議中は、そのすべてで黙っている。
cards.scene: A woman sits silently at a meeting table with five empty speech bubbles above her, while everyone else talks.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'proficient'.

cards.line: The king wishes to amend the law. Bedtime is now after dessert.
cards.lineJa: 王は、法の改正を望んでおられる。就寝時間は、デザートのあとになる。
cards.scene: A child king in an oversized crown stamps a scroll while ministers bow and a servant carries in a cake.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'amend'.

cards.line: The lease clearly says no pets, no parties, and no hauntings after ten.
cards.lineJa: 契約書には、はっきり書いてあります。ペット禁止、宴会禁止、夜10時以降の心霊現象禁止。
cards.scene: A landlord holds up a document to a group of guilty-looking ghosts floating in an old apartment.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'lease'.

cards.line: After the merger, the two companies now share one office and one stapler.
cards.lineJa: 合併のあと、2つの会社は、1つのオフィスと1つのホチキスを共有している。
cards.scene: Two groups of office workers in different colored uniforms play tug-of-war over a single stapler.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'merger'.

cards.line: Procurement is what we call it now. We used to call it treasure hunting.
cards.lineJa: 今では調達と呼んでいる。昔は、宝探しと呼んでいたがな。
cards.scene: Pirates wearing neckties carry a treasure chest through an office corridor, one of them checking a clipboard.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'procurement'.

cards.line: Our benchmark is simple: be slightly better than the office plant.
cards.lineJa: うちの基準は単純だ。オフィスの観葉植物より、少しだけましであること。
cards.scene: An employee and a potted plant sit at neighboring desks under a scoreboard, the plant wearing a tiny medal.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'benchmark'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: It is naive to think the cat will share the fish.
cards.lineJa: 猫が魚を分けてくれると思うのは、甘いよ。
cards.scene: A hopeful child holds out an empty plate toward a cat that hugs a large fish protectively.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'naive'.

cards.line: We must leverage our greatest strength: nobody knows what we do.
cards.lineJa: 我々の最大の強みを活用するのだ。我々が何をしているのか、誰も知らない、という強みを。
cards.scene: Shadowy executives lean over a table under a single hanging lamp, surrounded by blank charts.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'leverage'.

cards.line: The proprietor of this inn is a bear, so please compliment the honey.
cards.lineJa: この宿の主人は熊です。ですから、はちみつを褒めてください。
cards.scene: A large bear in an apron stands behind an inn counter proudly holding a jar of honey while nervous guests applaud.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'proprietor'.

cards.line: A good manager knows how to delegate. A great one delegates that too.
cards.lineJa: 良い管理職は、任せ方を知っている。偉大な管理職は、それすら人に任せる。
cards.scene: A manager lies in a hammock handing a folder to an assistant, who passes it along a long chain of people.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'delegate'.

cards.line: We decided to revamp the website. It is now the same, but blue.
cards.lineJa: ウェブサイトを一新することにしました。前と同じですが、青くなりました。
cards.scene: Designers proudly unveil a computer screen that looks exactly like the old one beside it, only in blue.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'revamp'.

cards.ja: 同意する、意見が一致する
cards.line: The council members concur. They have no idea what they agreed to.
cards.lineJa: 評議員は全員、同意している。何に同意したのかは、誰も分かっていない。
cards.scene: A row of solemn robed council members nod together, every one of them fast asleep.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'concur'.

cards.line: Staff turnover is high here. The last manager left during his welcome speech.
cards.lineJa: ここは離職率が高い。前の部長は、就任のあいさつの途中で辞めた。
cards.scene: A man walks away from a podium mid-speech carrying a box of belongings while the staff watch in confusion.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'turnover'.

cards.line: The wizard declared insolvency after turning all his gold into butterflies.
cards.lineJa: その魔法使いは、金貨をすべて蝶に変えてしまったあと、破産を申し立てた。
cards.scene: A wizard stares into an empty treasure chest as golden butterflies flutter out of the window.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'insolvency'.

cards.line: My supervisor says I have potential. He has said it for eleven years.
cards.lineJa: 上司は、私には将来性があると言う。11年間、そう言い続けている。
cards.scene: A graying employee sits at the same small desk under piles of old calendars while a supervisor gives a thumbs up.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'supervisor'.

cards.line: A spokesperson for the dragon said the village was already on fire.
cards.lineJa: ドラゴンの広報担当者は、村はもとから燃えていた、と述べた。
cards.scene: A small lizard in a suit speaks at a podium full of microphones while a dragon looks innocent behind it, smoke rising.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'spokesperson'.

cards.line: In a world of chaos, one accountant dares to ask for the receipts.
cards.lineJa: 混沌の世界で、ひとりの会計士が、あえて領収書を求める。
cards.scene: A heroic accountant holds a calculator like a shield against a tornado of flying papers.

voice.direction: Deep and epic, with dramatic pauses between sentences. Stress 'accountant'.

cards.line: The executives held a retreat to discuss why nobody likes retreats.
cards.lineJa: 重役たちは合宿を開いた。なぜ誰も合宿が好きではないのかを、話し合うために。
cards.scene: Executives in suits sit awkwardly on logs around a campfire in the woods, one standing at a flip chart.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'executive'.

cards.line: We must inform every stakeholder, including the ghost in the basement.
cards.lineJa: 利害関係者の全員に知らせなければならない。地下室の幽霊も含めて。
cards.scene: A manager with a clipboard waves from the basement stairs to a friendly ghost holding a coffee mug.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'stakeholder'.

cards.line: As his attorney, I advise my client to stay silent. He is a parrot and repeats everything.
cards.lineJa: 弁護士として、依頼人には黙秘を勧めます。彼はオウムで、何でもくり返してしまうので。
cards.scene: A lawyer in a courtroom gently holds the beak of a parrot perched on the witness stand.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'attorney'.

cards.line: Please revise the report. This time, try including some facts.
cards.lineJa: 報告書を修正してください。今回は、事実もいくつか入れてみましょう。
cards.scene: A supervisor hands back a report that is entirely covered with doodles of dragons to a smiling employee.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'revise'.

cards.line: Your free trial will terminate in three seconds. Thank you for your loyalty.
cards.lineJa: 無料お試し期間は、3秒後に終了します。ご愛顧ありがとうございました。
cards.scene: A robot waves goodbye as a trapdoor opens under a surprised customer sitting on a sofa.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'terminate'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: Dust and unread emails accumulate at exactly the same speed.
cards.lineJa: ほこりと未読メールは、まったく同じ速さでたまっていく。
cards.scene: A desk buried in thick dust and cobwebs, its computer screen overflowing with a pile of envelopes.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'accumulate'.

cards.line: We did not anticipate that the enemy would simply go home.
cards.lineJa: 敵がそのまま家に帰るとは、予期していなかった。
cards.scene: A fully armed army stands on a battlefield watching tiny enemy figures stroll away into the sunset.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'anticipate'.

cards.line: I can no longer distinguish Monday from Thursday, doctor.
cards.lineJa: 先生、もう月曜と木曜の区別がつきません。
cards.scene: A patient lies on a couch holding up two identical melting calendars while a doctor takes notes.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'distinguish'.

cards.line: These glasses enhance your vision and make you look like you read books.
cards.lineJa: この眼鏡は視力を高め、さらに、本を読む人のように見せてくれます。
cards.scene: A salesperson places glasses on a gorilla, who instantly looks scholarly and holds a thick book.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'enhance'.

cards.line: This is strictly confidential, so I have only told the whole office.
cards.lineJa: これは極秘だ。だから、オフィスの全員にしか話していない。
cards.scene: One office worker whispers into an ear, starting a chain of whisperers that loops around the whole office back to him.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'confidential'.

cards.line: The picnic caused considerable damage to the ant economy.
cards.lineJa: そのピクニックは、アリの経済に、かなりの損害を与えた。
cards.scene: A tiny ant city in the grass lies partly crushed under a giant picnic basket, ants surveying the damage.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'considerable'.

cards.line: Flying to work by broom is feasible, but parking is a nightmare.
cards.lineJa: ほうきで通勤するのは、実行可能だ。ただ、止める場所が悪夢だ。
cards.scene: A wizard hovers on a broom above a parking lot completely packed with other brooms.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'feasible'.

cards.line: My instructions were explicit: do not press the red button. Which one did you press?
cards.lineJa: 指示は明確だったはずだ。赤いボタンは押すな、と。で、どれを押した?
cards.scene: A supervisor covers her face while an employee keeps one finger on a glowing red button, alarms flashing in a lab.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'explicit'.

cards.line: The treasure is the goal. Any singing along the way is incidental.
cards.lineJa: 目的は宝だ。道中の歌は、ついでのものにすぎん。
cards.scene: Pirates row a boat singing happily while their stern captain points at a treasure map.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'incidental'.

cards.ja: うっかりの、不注意による
cards.line: It was an inadvertent mistake. I only replied to all four thousand people.
cards.lineJa: うっかりしたミスでした。4千人の全員に、返信しただけです。
cards.scene: A horrified worker at a computer watches thousands of glowing envelopes fly out toward a vast crowd.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'inadvertent'.

cards.line: Please share only pertinent details. I do not need to know about your cat.
cards.lineJa: 関連のある事柄だけを、お話しください。猫の話は結構です。
cards.scene: A tired detective rests his head on his hand while a witness eagerly shows him dozens of cat photographs.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'pertinent'.

cards.line: Snacks account for ninety percent of our office budget.
cards.lineJa: おやつが、うちのオフィスの予算の90パーセントを占めている。
cards.scene: A pie chart almost entirely one color stands beside a mountain of snacks while an accountant stares in shock.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'account for'.

cards.line: We have studied humans for years and still cannot figure out Mondays.
cards.lineJa: 我々は人類を何年も研究してきた。それでも、月曜日というものが理解できない。
cards.scene: Aliens peer through a window at gloomy commuters shuffling to work, scribbling notes in confusion.

voice.direction: Careful, curious, slightly stiff. Stress 'figure out'.

cards.line: I keep track of every coffee I drink. Today's number is not safe to say.
cards.lineJa: 飲んだコーヒーは、全部記録している。今日の数は、口に出せるものではない。
cards.scene: A jittery worker stands before a wall covered in tally marks beside a tall tower of empty coffee cups.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'keep track of'.

cards.ja: 効き始める、効力を発する
cards.line: The sleeping spell will take effect in ten seconds, so please sit down first.
cards.lineJa: 眠りの呪文は、10秒で効き始める。だから先に、座っておくように。
cards.scene: A wizard casts sparkles at a yawning knight standing on a ladder while helpers rush to place cushions below.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'take effect'.

cards.line: Please remove your armor prior to entering the swimming pool.
cards.lineJa: プールにお入りになる前に、鎧をお脱ぎください。
cards.scene: A lifeguard blows a whistle and points at a knight in full armor standing on the diving board.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'prior to'.

cards.line: The tortoise and the hare finished first and last, respectively.
cards.lineJa: カメとウサギは、それぞれ1位と最下位でゴールした。
cards.scene: A tortoise breaks the finish tape while a hare sleeps under a tree far behind, animals cheering.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'respectively'.

cards.line: Rainfall will increase substantially today, so bring a boat.
cards.lineJa: 本日の雨量は、大幅に増える見込みです。ボートをお持ちください。
cards.scene: A smiling weather presenter stands in a studio with water up to her waist while a commuter rows past behind her.

voice.direction: Brisk and sunny. Stress 'substantially'.

cards.ja: あるいは、その代わりに
cards.line: We could attack at dawn. Alternatively, we could all have breakfast.
cards.lineJa: 夜明けに攻撃することもできます。あるいは、みんなで朝食にすることも。
cards.scene: A soldier offers his general a choice, holding a sword in one hand and a pan of eggs in the other.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'alternatively'.

cards.ja: 資格のある、対象となる
cards.line: You are eligible for a free upgrade, because nobody else wanted the haunted room.
cards.lineJa: 無料でお部屋を格上げできます。幽霊の出る部屋を、ほかに誰も希望されなかったので。
cards.scene: A receptionist hands an ornate key to a tired traveler while a ghost waves from the top of a grand staircase.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'eligible'.

cards.line: All correspondence with the owl must be sent before midnight.
cards.lineJa: フクロウとのやり取りは、すべて真夜中までに送ること。
cards.scene: An owl wearing a postal cap stamps letters at a tiny desk by candlelight, a clock near midnight behind it.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'correspondence'.

cards.line: The memorandum about wasting paper was forty pages long.
cards.lineJa: 紙の無駄づかいについての社内文書は、40ページあった。
cards.scene: An employee holds a very thick stack of paper next to a printer that is still printing more.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'memorandum'.

cards.line: The staff directory lists forty employees and one very confident raccoon.
cards.lineJa: 社員名簿には、従業員40名と、やけに自信のあるアライグマ1匹が載っている。
cards.scene: An open binder of staff portrait photos, one of which shows a raccoon wearing a tie and smiling.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'directory'.

cards.line: No receipt, no refund. Those are the rules of the sea.
cards.lineJa: 領収書がなければ、返金もない。それが海の掟だ。
cards.scene: A pirate shopkeeper stands with arms crossed at a dockside stall while a sailor with a broken compass searches his pockets.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'receipt'.

cards.line: Nine out of ten dragons endorse this fire insurance.
cards.lineJa: ドラゴン10頭のうち9頭が、この火災保険を推薦しています。
cards.scene: A line of dragons give thumbs up beside a tiny insurance salesman, while one dragon looks away.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'endorse'.

cards.line: We need tangible results, not another beautiful chart.
cards.lineJa: 必要なのは、目に見える成果だ。きれいなグラフは、もういらない。
cards.scene: A boss pushes away a huge ornately framed chart that a proud employee presents like a painting.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'tangible'.

cards.line: The two kingdoms will consolidate their armies and their lunch menus.
cards.lineJa: 2つの王国は、軍隊と、昼食の献立を統合する。
cards.scene: Two kings shake hands while soldiers in two different colors share one long lunch table.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'consolidate'.

cards.line: This tea will alleviate your stress. Quitting your job would also work.
cards.lineJa: このお茶で、ストレスは和らぎます。仕事を辞めても、同じ効果があります。
cards.scene: A doctor hands a steaming cup of tea to a frazzled office worker whose hair stands on end.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'alleviate'.

cards.line: Details of the forthcoming party are secret, especially from the boss whose party it is.
cards.lineJa: 近く予定されているパーティーの詳細は、秘密です。とくに、主役である部長には。
cards.scene: Employees hide balloons and a cake behind their backs as a suspicious boss walks past.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'forthcoming'.

cards.line: The preliminary plan is to panic. The final plan is still under review.
cards.lineJa: 予備の計画は、あわてること。最終の計画は、まだ検討中です。
cards.scene: Officers run in circles inside a command tent while one calmly holds a clipboard.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'preliminary'.

cards.line: Your room is adjacent to the dragon's. He snores, but he is very polite.
cards.lineJa: お部屋はドラゴンの隣です。いびきはかきますが、とても礼儀正しい方です。
cards.scene: A hotel corridor with two doors, one enormous with smoke curling from under it, a bellhop pointing to the small door beside it.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'adjacent'.

cards.line: The fiscal year ended today. Nobody knows where it went.
cards.lineJa: 会計年度が、本日終わりました。どこへ行ったのかは、誰にも分かりません。
cards.scene: Accountants search under desks with flashlights while a calendar page blows out of the window.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'fiscal'.

cards.line: His credentials are impressive, but most of them are written in crayon.
cards.lineJa: 彼の経歴は見事だ。ただし、ほとんどがクレヨンで書かれている。
cards.scene: An interviewer examines a certificate drawn in crayon, held up proudly by a smiling man in a suit.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'credentials'.

cards.ja: 許可する、権限を与える
cards.line: I am not authorized to open this door. I am also not authorized to tell you why.
cards.lineJa: このドアを開ける権限は、私にはありません。理由をお伝えする権限も、ありません。
cards.scene: A robot guard stands before a huge vault door, shrugging at a waiting crowd.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'authorize'.

cards.line: We welcome all prospective customers, even the ones who are just here for the free coffee.
cards.lineJa: 見込みのあるお客様は、どなたでも歓迎します。無料のコーヒーが目当ての方も。
cards.scene: A showroom salesperson greets a crowd who all hold coffee cups and ignore the cars behind them.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'prospective'.

cards.line: My latest acquisition is the moon. The paperwork was terrible.
cards.lineJa: 最近の買収は、月だ。書類が、ひどく面倒だった。
cards.scene: A villain sits at a desk behind a mountain of forms, the full moon framed in the window behind him.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'acquisition'.

cards.line: The audit found three missing chairs and one extra ghost.
cards.lineJa: 監査の結果、椅子が3脚足りず、幽霊が1人多いことが分かりました。
cards.scene: An auditor with a clipboard counts chairs in an office while a ghost sits politely among the staff.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'audit'.

cards.line: Our subsidiary in the forest is run entirely by squirrels, and it is our most profitable one.
cards.lineJa: 森にあるうちの子会社は、リスだけで経営されている。しかも、いちばん儲かっている。
cards.scene: A tiny office inside a tree trunk where squirrels work at desks beside neat piles of acorns and coins.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'subsidiary'.

cards.ja: 精査する、細かく調べる
cards.line: Please scrutinize the contract. The last person who skipped page nine now owns a swamp.
cards.lineJa: 契約書を精査してください。前回、9ページ目を飛ばした人は、いま沼の持ち主です。
cards.scene: A man stands knee-deep in a swamp holding a contract while a lawyer inspects the paper with a magnifying glass.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'scrutinize'.

cards.line: According to our metrics, morale is high. According to everyone's faces, it is not.
cards.lineJa: 指標によれば、士気は高い。全員の顔によれば、高くない。
cards.scene: A boss points proudly at a rising chart in front of a row of gloomy employees.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'metrics'.

cards.line: To mitigate the risk of fire, we asked the dragon to work from home.
cards.lineJa: 火災のリスクを軽減するため、ドラゴンには在宅勤務をお願いしました。
cards.scene: A dragon sits at a home desk on a video call, while the office on its screen is full of fire extinguishers.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'mitigate'.

cards.line: During his long tenure, he attended ten thousand meetings and remembered none.
cards.lineJa: 長い在職期間のあいだに、彼は1万回の会議に出て、1つも覚えていない。
cards.scene: An old employee with a retirement cake stands before a wall of framed meeting photos, all of them blurred.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'tenure'.

cards.line: By royal mandate, Mondays are hereby cancelled.
cards.lineJa: 王の命令により、月曜日はここに廃止する。
cards.scene: A herald reads from a scroll on a balcony while the crowd below cheers and tears up calendars.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'mandate'.

cards.line: Turning lead into gold was a noble endeavor. Turning it into cheese was an accident.
cards.lineJa: 鉛を金に変えるのは、気高い試みだった。チーズに変えたのは、事故だった。
cards.scene: An alchemist stares at a wheel of cheese sitting on his workbench among bubbling flasks.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'endeavor'.

cards.line: This robust umbrella survives storms, hail, and small dragons.
cards.lineJa: この頑丈な傘は、嵐にも、ひょうにも、小さめのドラゴンにも耐えます。
cards.scene: A salesperson stands calmly under an umbrella while a small dragon breathes fire onto it.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'robust'.

cards.line: We do not solicit feedback after lunch. Everyone is too honest.
cards.lineJa: 昼食のあとには、意見を求めないことにしています。みんな、正直すぎるので。
cards.scene: A manager hides a suggestion box behind his back in front of sleepy, grumpy staff.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'solicit'.

cards.ja: 先送りにする、延期する
cards.line: Let us defer the decision until someone else makes it.
cards.lineJa: この決定は、先送りにしましょう。誰かほかの人が決めてくれるまで。
cards.scene: Committee members pass a steaming hot potato around a meeting table, each one leaning away from it.

voice.direction: Sincere and unhurried. Stress 'defer'.

cards.ja: 打ち勝つ、広く行き渡る
cards.line: In the end, common sense will prevail. Probably. Maybe next year.
cards.lineJa: 最後には、良識が勝つ。おそらく。来年あたりに。
cards.scene: A tiny knight with a lantern faces a towering monster made of paperwork.

voice.direction: Deep and epic, with dramatic pauses between sentences. Stress 'prevail'.

cards.line: A good leader listens to every subordinate, then does what the cat wants.
cards.lineJa: 良い上司は、部下全員の話を聞く。そのうえで、猫の望むとおりにする。
cards.scene: A boss listens to staff around a table while a cat sits on the keyboard looking in command.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'subordinate'.

cards.line: Our oldest patron has ordered the same soup since the year 1640.
cards.lineJa: いちばん古い常連のお客様は、1640年から同じスープを注文されています。
cards.scene: An elegant, very pale old gentleman in a cape sits at a restaurant table as a waiter bows with a bowl of soup.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'patron'.

cards.line: A pedestrian was overtaken by a snail this morning. He blames his shoes.
cards.lineJa: けさ、歩行者がカタツムリに追い抜かれました。本人は、靴のせいだと話しています。
cards.scene: A tired walker on a sidewalk looks down in dismay as a snail passes him.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'pedestrian'.

cards.line: The new tenant is quiet, pays on time, and walks through walls.
cards.lineJa: 新しい入居者は静かで、家賃も期日どおり。そして、壁を通り抜ける。
cards.scene: A landlord receives an envelope from a ghost who is halfway through the apartment wall.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'tenant'.

cards.line: The treasurer buried the budget on an island and lost the map.
cards.lineJa: 会計係は、予算を島に埋めて、地図をなくした。
cards.scene: A pirate accountant in spectacles digs holes all over a small island, looking worried.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'treasurer'.

cards.line: We paid a consultant to tell us what the intern said for free.
cards.lineJa: インターンがただで言ったことを言ってもらうために、コンサルタントにお金を払った。
cards.scene: A slick consultant presents a slide while an intern in the corner holds the same drawing on a napkin.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'consultant'.

cards.line: I commute two hours each way, mostly to think about quitting.
cards.lineJa: 片道2時間かけて通勤している。その時間は、ほとんど、辞めることを考えている。
cards.scene: A commuter on a packed train gazes dreamily at a daydream of a sunny beach.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'commute'.

cards.line: The recipient of this year's award could not attend, as he is a statue.
cards.lineJa: 今年の受賞者は、出席できませんでした。銅像ですので。
cards.scene: At an award ceremony, a trophy is placed in front of a stone statue while the audience applauds.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'recipient'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: Every expert was once a novice who refused to read the manual.
cards.lineJa: どんな達人も、昔は、説明書を読もうとしない初心者だった。
cards.scene: A grandmother knits expertly beside a child hopelessly tangled in yarn, a manual lying unopened on the floor.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'novice'.

cards.line: I nominate the cat for employee of the month. She is the only one who showed up.
cards.lineJa: 今月の優秀社員に、猫を推薦します。出社したのは、彼女だけなので。
cards.scene: A cat sits on a desk under a spotlight in an otherwise empty office.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'nominate'.

cards.line: I shall appoint my goldfish as vice president. He never argues.
cards.lineJa: 金魚を、副社長に任命する。あいつは、決して口答えしない。
cards.scene: A villain holds a tiny crown above a fishbowl sitting on an executive desk.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'appoint'.

cards.ja: 埋め合わせる、補償する
cards.line: They offered to compensate me for the delay with a coupon for more delays.
cards.lineJa: 遅延のお詫びに、と出されたのは、次の遅延に使えるクーポンだった。
cards.scene: An airline clerk hands a coupon to an exhausted traveler slumped on a suitcase.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, dry. Stress 'compensate'.

cards.line: We reached a compromise. Nobody is happy, so it must be fair.
cards.lineJa: 妥協点に達した。誰も満足していない。だから、きっと公平だ。
cards.scene: Two kings shake hands, both frowning, with frowning advisors lined up behind them.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'compromise'.

cards.ja: 実演する、はっきり示す
cards.line: Let me demonstrate how safe this ladder is. Please call a doctor.
cards.lineJa: このはしごの安全性を、実演いたします。…お医者さんを呼んでください。
cards.scene: A salesman falls from a ladder in mid-air, still smiling, while the audience gasps.

voice.direction: Energetic infomercial pitch. Stress 'demonstrate'.

cards.line: We need to procure forty swords, six cannons, and a decent coffee machine.
cards.lineJa: 剣を40本、大砲を6門、それと、まともなコーヒーメーカーを調達する必要がある。
cards.scene: A pirate quartermaster reads from a long list while the crew sadly holds up a broken coffee pot.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'procure'.

cards.ja: 互換性のある、相性のよい
cards.line: This printer is compatible with everything except paper.
cards.lineJa: このプリンターは、あらゆるものに対応しています。紙を除いて。
cards.scene: A robot presents a printer that is hopelessly jammed, crumpled paper scattered everywhere.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'compatible'.

cards.line: Attendance is compulsory. Enjoyment is optional.
cards.lineJa: 出席は義務です。楽しむかどうかは、任意です。
cards.scene: A stern trainer checks names at a seminar door as bored attendees shuffle in.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'compulsory'.

cards.line: He is running three concurrent projects and dropping all of them beautifully.
cards.lineJa: 彼は3つの案件を同時に進めていて、そのすべてを、見事に落としています。
cards.scene: A juggler in a suit gracefully drops three flaming folders while a crowd applauds.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'concurrent'.

cards.line: This is a genuine antique. I made it myself last week.
cards.lineJa: これは本物の骨董品です。先週、私がこの手で作りました。
cards.scene: A shady dealer proudly shows a vase with wet paint, a brush hidden behind his back.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'genuine'.

cards.line: Rain is imminent, according to my knee.
cards.lineJa: 雨が差し迫っています。私のひざによれば。
cards.scene: An old weather presenter points at his knee instead of the weather map as dark clouds gather.

voice.direction: Brisk and sunny. Stress 'imminent'.

cards.ja: 絶対に必要な、急を要する
cards.line: It is imperative that we look busy when the owner walks by.
cards.lineJa: オーナーが通りかかるときに、忙しそうに見えること。これが絶対に必要だ。
cards.scene: Employees type frantically on blank screens as a large shadow passes the glass door.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'imperative'.

cards.line: My skills became obsolete the day they invented the light bulb.
cards.lineJa: 電球が発明された日に、私の技術は時代遅れになった。
cards.scene: A sad lamplighter with a long pole watches bright electric street lamps glow.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'obsolete'.

cards.line: The optimal time to ask for a raise is never. I have run the numbers.
cards.lineJa: 昇給を願い出るのに最適な時期は、ありません。計算済みです。
cards.scene: A robot shows a completely flat graph to a hopeful employee.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'optimal'.

cards.ja: 許される、差し支えない
cards.line: Napping is permissible only if you call it deep thinking.
cards.lineJa: 居眠りは、熟考と呼ぶ場合にかぎり、許されます。
cards.scene: An employee sleeps at a desk in a thinker pose while a supervisor nods approvingly.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'permissible'.

cards.line: Our chef is renowned across three kingdoms for a soup nobody can identify.
cards.lineJa: 当店の料理長は、誰にも正体の分からないスープで、3つの王国に名を知られています。
cards.scene: A proud chef presents a glowing, mysterious soup to diners who peer at it nervously.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'renowned'.

cards.line: Sales have surpassed all expectations, mainly because we expected nothing.
cards.lineJa: 売上は、あらゆる予想を上回りました。主な理由は、何も期待していなかったからです。
cards.scene: A team celebrates a very tiny bar on a chart with confetti and party hats.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'surpass'.

cards.ja: 偶然見つける、出くわす
cards.line: If you come across a talking sword, do not ask it for directions.
cards.lineJa: しゃべる剣を見かけても、道を聞いてはいけない。
cards.scene: A lost traveler in a forest holds a glowing sword that points confidently in three directions at once.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'come across'.

cards.line: Draw up a contract. The kraken wants weekends off.
cards.lineJa: 契約書を作成しろ。クラーケンが、週末は休みたいそうだ。
cards.scene: A pirate lawyer writes at a desk while a giant tentacle reaches through the porthole holding a pen.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'draw up'.

cards.line: The company will phase out chairs to encourage shorter meetings.
cards.lineJa: 会社は、会議を短くするために、椅子を段階的に廃止します。
cards.scene: People stand uncomfortably around a meeting table as the very last chair is carried out of the room.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'phase out'.

cards.line: He put forward a bold idea, and then quietly backed away from it.
cards.lineJa: 彼は大胆な案を提案した。そして、そっと、その案から後ずさりした。
cards.scene: A man sets a glowing lightbulb on a meeting table and tiptoes backward away from it.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'put forward'.

cards.ja: 除外する、可能性を消す
cards.line: We cannot rule out the possibility that you are simply hungry.
cards.lineJa: 単にお腹が空いているだけ、という可能性も、除外できません。
cards.scene: A doctor examines a dramatically fainting patient while a sandwich sits untouched on the bedside table.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'rule out'.

cards.line: I had to turn down the promotion. It came with more meetings.
cards.lineJa: 昇進は、断るしかありませんでした。会議が増えるので。
cards.scene: An employee politely pushes back a crown offered by the boss, pointing at a calendar packed solid.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'turn down'.

cards.line: Owing to heavy fog, the lighthouse has lost the ship, and also itself.
cards.lineJa: 濃霧のため、灯台は船を見失いました。自分の居場所も。
cards.scene: A lighthouse stands in thick fog while its confused keeper turns a map around and around.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'owing to'.

cards.line: With regard to your request for a window, we have drawn one on the wall.
cards.lineJa: 窓がほしいというご要望に関しては、壁に1つ描いておきました。
cards.scene: An employee in a basement office stares at a window drawn in chalk on the bare wall.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'with regard to'.

cards.line: I asked the printer nicely, then firmly, then in tears, all to no avail.
cards.lineJa: プリンターに、やさしく頼み、きつく頼み、泣いて頼んだ。すべて無駄だった。
cards.scene: An office worker kneels before a printer, hands clasped, pleading with it.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'to no avail'.

cards.line: The office diet is predominantly cake, with occasional cake.
cards.lineJa: 職場の食生活は、主にケーキです。ときどき、ケーキもあります。
cards.scene: An office kitchen table is covered in cakes, with one sad apple left untouched.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'predominantly'.

cards.line: You are provisionally forgiven, until we find out what you did.
cards.lineJa: そなたを、暫定的に許す。何をしたのかが分かるまでの間だ。
cards.scene: A king waves his hand at a kneeling jester who hides something behind his back.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'provisionally'.

cards.line: She can type, talk, and worry concurrently.
cards.lineJa: 彼女は、打つ・話す・心配するを、同時にこなせる。
cards.scene: An office worker types with one hand, holds a phone with the other, and bites her nails all at once.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'concurrently'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: You are exceedingly brave, dear, or you did not read the sign.
cards.lineJa: あなたは、とても勇敢なのね。それとも、看板を読まなかったのね。
cards.scene: A child happily pets a sleeping bear beside a warning signpost while a grandmother watches.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'exceedingly'.

cards.line: The new plan is marginally better than having no plan at all.
cards.lineJa: 新しい計画は、計画が無いよりは、わずかにましです。
cards.scene: A commentator squints at two almost identical tiny trophies on a table.

voice.direction: Fast, excited play-by-play. Stress 'marginally'.

cards.line: The staff voted overwhelmingly in favor of going home.
cards.lineJa: 職員は、圧倒的多数で、帰宅に賛成しました。
cards.scene: Every hand in a meeting room is raised high, and everyone already has a coat on.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'overwhelmingly'.

cards.line: To expedite your order, we have attached it to an owl.
cards.lineJa: ご注文を迅速にお届けするため、フクロウにくくり付けました。
cards.scene: An owl flies off carrying a large box tied to it while a wizard clerk waves goodbye.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'expedite'.

cards.line: The dragon is amenable to peace talks, provided there are snacks.
cards.lineJa: ドラゴンは、和平交渉に快く応じる構えだ。おやつがあれば、の話だが。
cards.scene: A dragon sits at a negotiation table with knights, a plate of cookies in the center.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'amenable'.

cards.line: Here is an excerpt from the manual: do not, under any circumstances, press that.
cards.lineJa: 説明書からの抜粋です。「いかなる場合も、それを押してはいけません」。
cards.scene: An instructor reads from a booklet while a trainee keeps a finger hovering over a big button.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'excerpt'.

cards.line: You have nine hundred new notifications. None of them matter.
cards.lineJa: 新しい通知が、900件あります。大事なものは、ありません。
cards.scene: A person is buried under an avalanche of little bells pouring out of a phone while a robot calmly reports.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'notification'.

cards.line: The questionnaire asked how I felt. There was no box for tired.
cards.lineJa: アンケートは、私の気分をたずねてきた。「疲れた」の欄は、なかった。
cards.scene: An exhausted person stares at a form with a row of smiley faces, pen drooping in hand.

voice.direction: Cool, polite, dry. Stress 'questionnaire'.

cards.line: This voucher is good for one free hug from the manager, whether you want it or not.
cards.lineJa: この引換券で、店長のハグが1回無料になります。ご希望でなくても。
cards.scene: A huge smiling manager opens his arms wide while a customer holding a ticket backs away.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'voucher'.

cards.line: I sent the report in 1912 and I am still waiting for an acknowledgment.
cards.lineJa: 報告書は1912年に送った。受領の確認を、まだ待っている。
cards.scene: A ghost waits beside a cobwebbed mailbox holding a very old envelope.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'acknowledgment'.

cards.line: The first amendment to the royal diet adds a second dessert.
cards.lineJa: 王の献立に対する最初の修正案は、デザートを2品目に増やすものです。
cards.scene: A scribe adds a line to a long scroll while a king nods happily between two cakes.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'amendment'.

cards.line: Your remittance arrived, but it was mostly seashells.
cards.lineJa: 送金は届いた。だが、中身はほとんど貝殻だった。
cards.scene: A pirate opens a treasure chest full of seashells while a parrot laughs.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'remittance'.

cards.line: Shouting at the computer will only exacerbate the problem, and your blood pressure.
cards.lineJa: パソコンに怒鳴っても、問題を悪化させるだけです。血圧も。
cards.scene: A red-faced worker yells at a computer screen while a doctor calmly measures his blood pressure.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'exacerbate'.

cards.line: He wields a stapler like a sword, and paperwork fears him.
cards.lineJa: 彼は、ホチキスを剣のように振るう。書類は、彼を恐れている。
cards.scene: An office hero slashes through a storm of flying papers with a stapler.

voice.direction: Deep and epic, with dramatic pauses between sentences. Stress 'wield'.

cards.line: Touching my sandwich is tantamount to declaring war.
cards.lineJa: 私のサンドイッチに触れることは、宣戦布告に等しい。
cards.scene: A menacing figure guards a sandwich inside an open office fridge, tiny flags planted around it.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'tantamount'.

cards.line: Under closer scrutiny, the mysterious monster turned out to be a coat on a chair.
cards.lineJa: 詳しく調べたところ、謎の怪物の正体は、椅子にかけたコートだった。
cards.scene: A detective shines a flashlight on a coat draped over a chair that casts a monster-shaped shadow.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'scrutiny'.

cards.line: Switching to auxiliary power. Please stop charging your phone on me.
cards.lineJa: 補助電源に切り替えます。私で携帯を充電するのは、おやめください。
cards.scene: A robot with dimming eyes has a dozen phone cables plugged into its body.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'auxiliary'.

cards.line: We have a surplus of treasure and a shortage of places to hide it.
cards.lineJa: 宝は余っている。隠す場所が、足りない。
cards.scene: Pirates stand on a tiny crowded island surrounded by overflowing treasure chests.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'surplus'.

cards.line: I wrote a comprehensive guide to the office. Chapter one is where the snacks are.
cards.lineJa: 職場の総合ガイドを書きました。第1章は、おやつの場所です。
cards.scene: An employee hands a very thick book to a newcomer, a snack drawer glowing in the background.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'comprehensive'.

cards.line: Cats are exempt from all palace rules, as always.
cards.lineJa: 猫は、いつものとおり、宮殿のすべての規則を免除されている。
cards.scene: A cat strolls across a royal banquet table while the palace guards salute.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'exempt'.

cards.ja: 規定する、条件として定める
cards.line: The contract stipulates that the ghost may stay, provided he stops rearranging the furniture.
cards.lineJa: 契約書は、幽霊の居住を認めると定めている。家具の配置を勝手に変えないことが条件だ。
cards.scene: A lawyer points at a contract while a guilty ghost holds an armchair in mid-air.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'stipulate'.

cards.line: To curtail costs, the Christmas party will be held in July, by email.
cards.lineJa: 経費削減のため、クリスマス会は7月に、メールで行います。
cards.scene: A lonely employee at a desk wears a Santa hat in summer heat, reading an email.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'curtail'.

cards.ja: 開通させる、正式に始める
cards.line: Today we inaugurate the new bridge. Please do not all cross it at once.
cards.lineJa: 本日、新しい橋を開通させます。全員で一度に渡らないでください。
cards.scene: A mayor holds scissors at a ribbon in front of a rickety bridge while a crowd waits eagerly.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'inaugurate'.

cards.line: I remunerate my minions generously, in compliments.
cards.lineJa: 手下への報酬は、気前よく払っている。褒め言葉で。
cards.scene: A villain pats a minion on the head while the minion holds up an empty wallet.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'remunerate'.

cards.line: The picnic is contingent on the weather, and the weather is contingent on my mood.
cards.lineJa: ピクニックは天気しだい。天気は、私の機嫌しだいだ。
cards.scene: A weather wizard sits on a cloud holding a sun in one hand and a storm in the other above a picnic.

voice.direction: Brisk and sunny. Stress 'contingent'.

cards.line: He is a strong proponent of teamwork, as long as someone else does it.
cards.lineJa: 彼は、チームワークの熱心な支持者だ。誰かほかの人がやるかぎりは。
cards.scene: A man cheers with pom-poms while his teammates carry a heavy log.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'proponent'.

cards.line: Nobody considered the ramifications of teaching the broom to walk.
cards.lineJa: ほうきに歩き方を教えたらどうなるか、誰も考えていなかった。
cards.scene: An army of walking brooms carrying buckets floods a castle hall as a wizard looks on in horror.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'ramification'.

cards.line: The litigation lasted so long that all the lawyers are now ghosts.
cards.lineJa: 訴訟はあまりに長く続き、弁護士は今や、全員が幽霊だ。
cards.scene: Ghostly lawyers still argue passionately in a dusty, cobwebbed courtroom.

voice.direction: Hollow, soft, deadpan. Stress 'litigation'.

cards.line: According to the prospectus, the castle has charm, history, and only one curse.
cards.lineJa: 案内書によれば、この城には、趣と歴史と、たった1つの呪いがあります。
cards.scene: A cheerful realtor shows a booklet in front of a crumbling castle with bats circling.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'prospectus'.

cards.line: Interest will accrue daily. So will my disappointment.
cards.lineJa: 利息は、日々たまっていきます。私の失望も、同じです。
cards.scene: A bank robot shows a rising counter to a customer who seems to be shrinking.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'accrue'.

cards.line: The best amenity in this hotel is a friendly sea monster who hands out towels.
cards.lineJa: 当ホテルいちばんの設備は、タオルを配ってくれる、人なつこい海の怪物です。
cards.scene: A tentacle rises from a hotel pool offering a folded towel to a surprised guest.

voice.direction: Warm, professional, perfectly calm. Stress 'amenity'.

cards.line: The affluent neighborhood now has a fountain that pours hot chocolate.
cards.lineJa: その裕福な地区には、いまや、ホットチョコレートの噴水がある。
cards.scene: An elegant plaza with a chocolate fountain where well-dressed people fill their cups.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'affluent'.

cards.line: This is only a provisional victory. The enemy is still at lunch.
cards.lineJa: これは暫定的な勝利にすぎない。敵は、まだ昼食中だ。
cards.scene: An army celebrates on an empty battlefield while the enemy picnics on a distant hill.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'provisional'.

cards.line: I tried to resign, but my boss resigned first, and now I am the boss.
cards.lineJa: 辞めようとしたら、上司が先に辞めた。そして今、私が上司だ。
cards.scene: A stunned employee sits in a big executive chair still holding a resignation letter.

voice.direction: Quiet, dry, like reading a diary. Stress 'resign'.

cards.line: Please designate one person to panic, so the rest of us can work.
cards.lineJa: あわてる係を1人、指名してください。残りの者が仕事をできるように。
cards.scene: One person screams inside a circle marked on the office floor while everyone else works calmly.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'designate'.

cards.toneJa: おばあちゃんの見立て
cards.line: He devoted forty years to this company, and the company gave him a pen.
cards.lineJa: 彼は40年をこの会社に捧げ、会社は彼に、ペンを1本贈った。
cards.scene: An old man at a retirement party holds up a single pen.

voice.direction: Kind, slow, a little amused. Stress 'devote'.

cards.line: I cannot disclose my source, mostly because it was my mother.
cards.lineJa: 情報源は明かせない。主な理由は、それが母だからだ。
cards.scene: A detective speaks at a press conference while his mother waves proudly from the audience.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'disclose'.

cards.line: Reading the comments is detrimental to your health.
cards.lineJa: コメント欄を読むことは、健康に有害です。
cards.scene: A doctor shakes her head at a patient whose phone gives off dark, spiky speech bubbles.

voice.direction: Gentle, clinical, matter-of-fact. Stress 'detrimental'.

cards.line: My plan is elaborate, expensive, and defeated by a single locked door.
cards.lineJa: 我が計画は、手が込んでいて、金がかかっていて、鍵のかかったドア1枚に敗れた。
cards.scene: A villain with a gigantic machine and blueprints stands stuck in front of a small locked door.

voice.direction: Booming and proud. Stress 'elaborate'.

cards.line: Piracy was lucrative until they invented receipts.
cards.lineJa: 海賊業は、もうかった。領収書が発明されるまでは。
cards.scene: A gloomy pirate files receipts at a desk on the deck of his ship.

voice.direction: Rough growl, but businesslike. Stress 'lucrative'.

cards.line: She is so meticulous that she alphabetized the office plants.
cards.lineJa: 彼女はあまりに几帳面で、職場の観葉植物を、名前の順に並べた。
cards.scene: A woman adjusts a perfectly straight row of potted plants, each with a tiny tag.

voice.direction: Low conspiratorial tone, enjoying the gossip. Stress 'meticulous'.

cards.line: A dragon ate my report is a plausible excuse in this office.
cards.lineJa: 「ドラゴンがレポートを食べました」は、この職場では、もっともらしい言い訳です。
cards.scene: An employee points at a dragon chewing paper in an open-plan office while coworkers look unsurprised.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'plausible'.

cards.ja: 無視できるほど小さい
cards.line: The chance of success is negligible. I recommend trying anyway, for entertainment.
cards.lineJa: 成功の見込みは、無視できるほど小さいです。娯楽として、試すことをおすすめします。
cards.scene: A robot holds a bucket of popcorn while a human prepares to jump across a canyon.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'negligible'.

cards.line: Our contingency plan is to run. Our backup contingency plan is to run faster.
cards.lineJa: 不測の事態への備えは、逃げること。その予備の備えは、もっと速く逃げることだ。
cards.scene: A general draws big arrows on a map, all pointing away from the enemy.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'contingency'.

cards.line: There is a growing disparity between what we planned and what happened.
cards.lineJa: 計画したことと、実際に起きたことの差が、広がっています。
cards.scene: A beautiful blueprint of a tower hangs beside a leaning pile of bricks.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'disparity'.

cards.line: In lieu of a bonus, everyone will receive a firm handshake.
cards.lineJa: ボーナスの代わりに、全員に、力強い握手を贈ります。
cards.scene: A boss shakes hands down a long line of disappointed employees.

voice.direction: Cold and flat, no joy at all. Stress 'in lieu of'.

cards.line: In compliance with safety rules, the fire-breathing act will now be performed underwater.
cards.lineJa: 安全規則に従い、火吹きの芸は、これより水中で行います。
cards.scene: A circus performer in a water tank tries to breathe fire, producing only bubbles.

voice.direction: Smooth public-announcement voice, perfectly calm. Stress 'in compliance with'.

cards.line: Let us wrap up this meeting before it becomes tomorrow.
cards.lineJa: この会議を終わらせましょう。明日になる前に。
cards.scene: A meeting room at night with the moon in the window and half the attendees asleep.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'wrap up'.

cards.line: This potion works best in conjunction with a long nap.
cards.lineJa: この薬は、長い昼寝と組み合わせると、いちばんよく効く。
cards.scene: A wizard hands a potion to a yawning patient who is already hugging a pillow.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'in conjunction with'.

cards.line: I have several questions pertaining to the missing cheese.
cards.lineJa: 消えたチーズに関して、いくつか質問があります。
cards.scene: A detective interrogates a mouse sitting on a tiny chair under a desk lamp.

voice.direction: Low, slow and suspicious, treating it as a serious case. Stress 'pertaining to'.

cards.line: I inadvertently sent my shopping list to the entire company.
cards.lineJa: うっかり、買い物リストを全社員に送ってしまいました。
cards.scene: Every screen in an office shows a grocery list while one employee hides under a desk.

voice.direction: Apologetic and a little embarrassed. Stress 'inadvertently'.

cards.line: The attack is tentatively scheduled for Tuesday, if nobody is busy.
cards.lineJa: 攻撃は、仮に火曜日の予定だ。誰も忙しくなければ。
cards.scene: Soldiers check their personal calendars around a war table.

voice.direction: Tries to sound confident, not quite managing. Stress 'tentatively'.

cards.line: The council voted unanimously to blame the weather.
cards.lineJa: 評議会は、満場一致で、天気のせいにすることを決めた。
cards.scene: A whole council points out of the window at a rain cloud.

voice.direction: Formal and grave, announcing state business. Stress 'unanimously'.

cards.ja: 断続的に、途切れ途切れに
cards.line: The elevator works intermittently, like my enthusiasm.
cards.lineJa: エレベーターは、途切れ途切れに動きます。私のやる気と同じです。
cards.scene: A robot leans beside an elevator stuck halfway between two floors.

voice.direction: Flat, even, mechanical rhythm with tiny pauses. Stress 'intermittently'.

cards.line: The salary is commensurate with experience, and the experience is mostly waiting.
cards.lineJa: 給与は経験に見合ったものです。その経験とは、主に、待つことです。
cards.scene: A smiling interviewer sits before a very long waiting room where one applicant has turned into a skeleton.

voice.direction: Bright and delighted, customer-service cheer. Stress 'commensurate'.

cards.line: The meeting transcript is one page: someone said hello, then nothing.
cards.lineJa: 会議の記録は1ページだ。誰かが「こんにちは」と言い、あとは何もなかった。
cards.scene: A stenographer holds an almost blank sheet in a completely silent meeting.

voice.direction: Crisp headline delivery, neutral. Stress 'transcript'.

cards.line: The answer is in the appendix, which nobody has ever opened.
cards.lineJa: 答えは付録にある。誰ひとり開いたことのない、あの付録に。
cards.scene: A student blows dust off the cobwebbed back section of a giant book.

voice.direction: Polite, but tired of repeating it. Stress 'appendix'.

cards.line: The ancient manuscript reveals the secret of eternal life, but page two is missing.
cards.lineJa: その古い原稿は、永遠の命の秘密を明かしている。ただ、2ページ目が無い。
cards.scene: A scholar holds one glowing page and searches frantically among piles of scrolls.

voice.direction: Weary, dry, with a small sigh. Stress 'manuscript'.

cards.line: This notice supersedes all previous notices, including the one that superseded them.
cards.lineJa: この通知は、これまでのすべての通知に取って代わります。それらに取って代わった通知にも、です。
cards.scene: A robot pins yet another sheet onto a bulletin board buried under layers of notices.
